tasks.title: Initialize SessionApi.now_fn in constructor to prevent AttributeError in _append_audit
acceptance_criteria: SessionApi.__init__ accepts an optional parameter now_fn defaulting to None (e.g. now_fn: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None) and binds it to self.now_fn.
Constructing SessionApi(db) without a now_fn argument successfully sets self.now_fn to None.
Calling transition(session_id, to_phase) on a default-constructed SessionApi writes the audit log and does not raise AttributeError: 'SessionApi' object has no attribute 'now_fn'.
The optional 'ts' key is omitted in the audit log when now_fn is None, preserving the original _append_audit logic.
All other signatures, return values, and behavior of transition, _append_audit, create_session, and other methods remain completely unchanged.
No new module-level symbols, network calls, wall-clocks, randomness, or third-party imports are introduced; ngv2/session_gate.py is not touched or imported.

spec.objective: Prevent AttributeError in SessionApi._append_audit by defining self.now_fn at constructor initialization time, supporting both None and injected callable timestamp sources.
functional_requirements: Add an injectable now_fn parameter to SessionApi.__init__ that defaults to None.
Assign self.now_fn = now_fn within the SessionApi constructor.
Ensure SessionApi(db) sets self.now_fn to None, causing transitions to skip timestamp injection but still write the audit log successfully without raising AttributeError.
spec.interfaces: SessionApi.__init__(self, db: Any = None, now_fn: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None) -> None. Marks self.now_fn as an attribute.
edge_cases: Construction with only positional db: now_fn defaults to None, hasattr(api, 'now_fn') is True.
Injected now_fn raises exception: the existing try/except block in _append_audit catches it and passes, omitting 'ts' without propagating.
Unknown session transition: still returns a 404 envelope before _append_audit is reached, handled per existing logic.
non_goals: Do NOT add integration/e2e tests; the unit test oracle tests/ngv2/test_session_api_audit_now_fn_wired.py is authoritative.
Do NOT author or modify any test file.
Do NOT default now_fn to a real wall-clock (like time.time or datetime.now) to keep construction deterministic.
Do NOT touch ngv2/session_gate.py or depend on it.
Do NOT edit any file other than ngv2/session_api.py.
spec.implementation_notes:
Modify ngv2/session_api.py around line 60. Change def __init__(self, db: Any=None) -> None: to def __init__(self, db: Any=None, now_fn: Optional[Callable[[], Any]]=None) -> None:. Bind self.now_fn = now_fn. Typing symbols (Optional, Callable) might be imported already. Do not change _append_audit or transition logic.

# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_session_api_audit_now_fn_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2/session_api.py SessionApi.now_fn initialization
(EDIT, additive __init__ fix).

DEFECT under test (verified live 2026-06-11 via _e2e_run/drive.py line 114):
``SessionApi._append_audit`` (~line 228) reads ``if self.now_fn is not None:``
to optionally stamp an injected timestamp onto the audit record. But
``SessionApi.__init__`` (``def __init__(self, db=None)``) NEVER initializes a
``now_fn`` attribute -- the audit-timestamp support was added to
``_append_audit`` without updating the constructor. ``_append_audit`` is reached
on EVERY ``transition`` attempt (it audits allowed, disallowed, and gate-fail
transitions alike), BEFORE any return. So constructing the handler exactly the
way production does -- ``api = SessionApi(db)`` (see _e2e_run/drive.py line 94,
no ``now_fn`` kwarg) -- and calling ``api.transition(sid, to_phase)`` raises::

    AttributeError: 'SessionApi' object has no attribute 'now_fn'

inside ``_append_audit``, before the audit row can be written.

FIX the blind worker MUST build (pinned by this oracle):
``SessionApi.__init__`` MUST initialize ``self.now_fn`` (an injectable parameter
defaulting to ``None``) so ``_append_audit``'s existing
``if self.now_fn is not None:`` branch is well-defined. The default (no kwarg)
construction MUST leave ``now_fn`` as ``None``, preserving the existing branch
semantics: the optional ``'ts'`` key is simply omitted, and a deterministic
audit record is still written on every transition attempt.

WIRING: this oracle imports and drives the live ngv2.session_api.SessionApi over
a real ngv2.session_db.SessionDB, constructing it exactly as _e2e_run/drive.py
does (positional ``db`` only, NO ``now_fn`` kwarg workaround), proving the edited
constructor is reachable on the live transition/audit path. It deliberately does
NOT import ngv2.session_gate (currently un-importable; fix in flight) -- the
now_fn defect surfaces in ``_append_audit`` regardless of gate availability,
since the audit row is always written before the gate verdict is consulted.
meta_task_type: validation (an EDIT to an existing module; integration excused
via the brief's Non-Goals).
"""
import pytest

from ngv2.session_db import SessionDB
from ngv2.session_api import SessionApi


@pytest.fixture()
def api(tmp_path):
    db = SessionDB(str(tmp_path / "s.db"))
    try:
        yield SessionApi(db)
    finally:
        db.close()


# --- sanity: production constructs SessionApi with NO now_fn kwarg ----------

def test_default_construction_has_now_fn_attribute(api):
    """After the fix, the constructor MUST define ``now_fn`` (defaulting to
    None) even when built positionally as production does (drive.py line 94).
    Currently RED: ``SessionApi(db)`` never sets ``now_fn``."""
    assert hasattr(api, "now_fn"), "SessionApi.__init__ must initialize now_fn"
    assert api.now_fn is None


# --- headline defect: transition runs _append_audit without AttributeError --

def test_transition_runs_append_audit_without_attributeerror(api):
    """Construct exactly as _e2e_run/drive.py does and drive a transition.

    ``transition`` always calls ``_append_audit`` before returning, so the
    missing ``now_fn`` attribute raises AttributeError here today. After the
    fix the call completes and a deterministic audit row is written.
    """
    api.create_session("s1", {"repo_root": "/svc/example"})
    # No now_fn kwarg -- mirrors production SessionApi(db) construction.
    resp = api.transition("s1", "triage")
    assert isinstance(resp, dict)
    # Whatever the gate verdict, _append_audit must have recorded the attempt.
    logs = api.db.get_phase_validation_logs()
    assert logs, "transition must persist an audit row via _append_audit"
    last = logs[-1]
    assert last.get("from") == "hunt"
    assert last.get("to") == "triage"
    # Default (now_fn is None) construction omits the optional timestamp.
    assert "ts" not in last


# --- audit row written on EVERY transition attempt, default construction ----

def test_unknown_session_transition_does_not_touch_now_fn(api):
    """A 404 (unknown session) returns before _append_audit, so it must not
    raise regardless of now_fn -- guards against an over-broad fix that moves
    audit before the existence check."""
    resp = api.transition("missing", "triage")
    assert resp.get("status") == 404

```
